meta.description: AI Agency prompt library for content generation

landing_hero_image.description: Hero section image for SaaS landing page
landing_hero_image.prompt: Clean modern SaaS dashboard interface floating in 3D space, glass morphism design, gradient purple-blue background, data visualization charts, minimalist UI elements, professional tech aesthetic, 8k quality, studio lighting
landing_hero_image.negative_prompt: text, watermark, blurry, low quality, distorted

feature_icons.description: Feature section icons for SaaS product

onboarding_illustration.prompt: Flat illustration of {step_description}, modern tech style, limited color palette of {brand_colors}, clean lines, friendly and approachable, white background

social_media_post.description: Social media content for SaaS promotion

hero_background.description: Full-width hero background for landing page

team_photo_style.description: Team/about section professional photos style guide

bot_avatar.prompt: Cute friendly robot mascot icon, {color} color scheme, modern flat design with subtle 3D effect, circular composition, clean edges perfect for avatar, {personality} expression
